query: What is the maximum file size and maximum number of files per batch for AEP batch ingestion?

results.title: Batch ingestion overview
results.content: Batch ingestion lets you ingest data into Adobe Experience Platform as batches. Create a batch, upload one or more files to it, then signal completion so the batch is promoted.

results.title: Supported file formats
results.content: Batch ingestion supports Parquet, JSON, and CSV files.
